terra.problem: The passage does not identify the high priest as the head of the council.
The permission-slip joke brings in a school scenario.
It states that the council would know Abraham's name well, but the text does not say what they knew.
Genesis 6:14 records the instruction to build the ark, not that Noah built it. Genesis 6:22 supports that fact.
The real-estate joke makes God's promise itself the subject of the joke.
The text does not say how long before Abraham had a child God said this.
The claim that God never sends Abraham's descendants back to the land he left to worship goes beyond what this passage says.
Joseph was one of Jacob's twelve sons, so the twelve cannot all be Joseph's brothers.
Jacob's name appears in verse 8, before Joseph is sold and before the famine.
The text says God would punish the nation that enslaved Abraham's descendants; it does not say the individual oppressors here were going to be punished.
The line says “test” is close in sound to “deliver,” but the words do not sound alike.
It reduces the remark that prompted Moses to flee to one question. The man also asked whether Moses wanted to kill him as he had killed the Egyptian.
The text says Moses received living words to pass on, not that he had just brought them to the people.
